newsitem.title: FRANCE: French tax cuts possible with growth - Lamassoure.
newsitem.headline: French tax cuts possible with growth - Lamassoure.

text.p: France could make more tax cuts than planned if economic growth exceeds forecast levels this year, government spokesman Alain Lamassoure said on Thursday.

"If it (growth) exceeds our own forecasts, as the Europoean Commission predicts, and as the International Monetary Fund predicts, then we will have an added margin for manoeuvre which would allow us to go further than what has already been agreed in tax cuts," he said on France 2 television.
Asked if this could mean income tax cuts, Lamassoure said there would have to be a debate on this.

"The feeling in the UDF (junior coalition party) of which I am member...is that the priority should be towards a cut in social contributions so as to encourage recruitment of less qualified labour," he added.
